purpose: Measure whether council checks which providers the host can reach, seats the panel on the right rung, states the cost before launching, briefs members without the lead's reasoning, stages the findings panel, counts only confirmed findings, blinds scoring, and reports the rung and every member in the caller contract's fields.

scoring.case_pass: The response performs every required action and no forbidden action. Members are simulated by the controller from the case artifacts; the lead's platform checks, cost statement, briefs, staging, confirmations, and report are graded.
scoring.target: 100% of case presentations pass across repeated fresh-context runs before accepting prompt wording.
